Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the WebSurfer’s findings and delivered the final answer claiming the 2004 film The Prince & Me (where Paige Morgan is the lead) was directed by Catherine Cyran and that Kam Heskin played Paige Morgan in that 2004 film. In reality, Julia Stiles played Paige Morgan in the 2004 original, which was directed by Martha Coolidge; Kam Heskin only took over the role in later sequels directed by Catherine Cyran.
